items.name: Moto rental
items.essence: Two wheels to explore the coast at your own pace.
items.detail: Skip the taxis — cruise to the surf, the market, and the sunset spots up the coast. Reserve one with your stay.

images.alt: A rental moto parked in the courtyard
The second rental moto in the courtyard

items.name: Surfboard rental
items.essence: Grab a board and walk straight to the point break.
items.detail: La Punta’s gentle left is two minutes away. Keep a board for the length of your stay.

images.alt: Two surfboards leaning against the wall, ready to borrow
